status: Requested exploratory D/E ablations, fixed after C's results and before any D/E predictions
rationale: C delivered a paired Acc@25, mIoU and measured return-association improvement, so the proposal's remaining component comparisons are informative. It did not pass the original positive-Acc@50 criterion; the exploratory ablations cannot reverse that registered C verdict and do not support independent validation.
data: The same fixed 96 frames and original Qwen outputs. For source-dependent 3EED terms compare its 192 original incoming source directions. Normalize v3 captions using the registered ordinary Validation loader. No training and no target parameter updates.
D_noun: On C's exact eligible nodes, multiply the sealed visual correspondence by the original subject phrase nominations, marginal region occupancy and frozen subject noun probability. Keep Qwen bearing, dimensions, original camera-frame orientation and A's front-surface offset. If the noun is unsupported or utility is identically zero, fall back to C.
D_joint: Where v3 reads a recognized two-noun spatial relation, use the entire original feasible joint-subject utility, including its original ordinary and ordered branches, times the same sealed visual correspondence. Else use D_noun. If the relation has no feasible eligible node use D_noun. D's projected region supports and selected-node depths are from C's full-tree arm and its same fitting cells.
E_v3_box: Use the D_joint-selected node and its own noun dimensions with the unchanged regions.complete. When a noun was not available, fall back to D_joint.
E_qwen_size: Use the same D_joint-selected node and the Qwen sensor-frame upright side lengths as the size prior. Compute visible-face anchoring with the existing complete rule on the node's measured PCA axes.
E_qwen_pose: Use the same D_joint-selected node. Convert Qwen's released 9D camera box and extent through the verified upright 7D projection. Rotate axial yaw into the target model frame and remeasure the point support and terrain-aligned bottom in that orientation. Use Qwen dimensions in that ordering as lower bounds and retain the sensor-facing horizontal slabs and bottom during expansion.
fallback: Retain every original failure. If C has no eligible node, D and E return its unchanged Qwen output. Keep every result and negative, also report strict-only v3 entry.
selection: All variants are prespecified, report the whole panel with no per-platform default selection. This is a same-panel component screen, not an independent test.
